nodes.name: BrandsPage CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the Brands management page. Defines a square brand avatar with primary-color background, role badges in three variants (primary, parts_only, both) using semantic color tokens, and an active/inactive status dot indicator rendered via a CSS pseudo-element.

nodes.name: CatalogPage CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the main product catalog listing page. Provides a responsive auto-fill product grid (minmax 220px), a card skeleton loader with pulse animation, a centered empty-state layout, and a grid/list view-toggle button group. Includes a mobile breakpoint that tightens column width to 160px.

nodes.name: CategoriesPage CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the Categories management page. Implements a hierarchical tree table with three nesting levels distinguished by colored dots (primary, purple, info), an expand/collapse toggle button, alternating row backgrounds for child levels, bilingual name display (main + secondary), and shared active/inactive status dot indicators.

nodes.name: ProductDetailPage CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the Product Detail page — the most complex CSS file in the Catalog module. Covers a two-column responsive layout (collapses to one column on mobile), an image gallery with main viewer, left/right arrow navigation, thumbnail strip, and a full-screen lightbox overlay. Also styles the info column (brand label, product name, badges using color-mix, metadata definition list, compatibility chips, bilingual name), a grouped specifications table with striped rows, and a two-column skeleton loading state.

nodes.name: ImportPage CSS
nodes.summary: Styles for the Product Import wizard page (listed as ProductsPage.css in the batch manifest, but the actual file on disk is ImportPage.css). Provides a multi-step progress indicator with active/done state transitions, a dashed file dropzone with hover/dragging/has-file state variants, import action buttons, a warning info box, preview summary cards (total/valid/error counts), expandable sheet/tab cards with per-row create/update action badges, and a result banner in success/partial states. Includes a CSS spin keyframe for loading icons.

edges.label: Both are catalog listing/management page styles with badge/indicator patterns
